description: NcTypeMask::IP_ADDRESS (lib.rs:1510) is defined and name_type_bit returns it for IpAddress GeneralNames (line 1544), but check_name_constraints never checks whether IP address names are constrained (nc_constrained_types.intersects(NcTypeMask::IP_ADDRESS)). The CheckMode::Permitted path in check_names (line 2793) calls type_constrained(name) which correctly uses nc_constrained_types.intersects(name_type_bit(name)), so IP_ADDRESS IS handled correctly via that path. However there is no inline direct-comparison path for IpAddress in the subject DN treatment (there cannot be — IP addresses don't appear in DNs). This is fine. Verify no coverage gap exists for SAN IpAddress entries and document why IpAddress has no DN-direct-comparison code path (it is already covered by the SAN loop). Currently misleading because the bitmask bit exists but looks unused to readers.
title: pkix-path: NcTypeMask::IP_ADDRESS defined but never checked in nc_constrained_types
